deadline.value: The page gives no closing date. Applications for acceptance are made online in Promovendus, which the page says can be reached at any time.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A professor or young investigator in the faculty must agree to supervise you, recorded in the supervision agreement.
supervisor.quote: Zudem benötigen Sie eine/n Hochschullehrer/in / Young Investigator der Fakultät Bauingenieurwesen, der/die sich bereit erklärt, die wissenschaftliche Betreuung Ihrer Promotion zu übernehmen

funding.value: The pages checked do not state how many doctoral candidates are funded.

entry_route.value: A Diploma, Master or Magister, or state exam, in engineering with at least a good grade. Non-engineering degrees also need an aptitude test.
entry_route.quote: einen Diplom-, Master- oder Magistergrad an einer Hochschule oder das Staatsexamen in einem ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Studiengang

notes: The faculty page is in German, and its regulations date from 19 December 2024. Admission requires a grade of at least good, and the thesis grade too.
